uncited: Hierarchical DDA Traversal extends standard DDA [DDA](2323-dda.md) to efficiently traverse sparse, multi-resolution volume structures by adapting step sizes to the current tree level [Hierarchical Digital Differential Analyzer (HDDA)](1122-hierarchical-digital-differential-analyzer-hdda.md)[Multi-level DDA with Adaptive Mip Selection](4086-multi-level-dda-with-adaptive-mip-selection.md).

Unlike sibling methods that step voxel-by-voxel [Amanatides-Woo Voxel Traversal](3132-amanatides-woo-voxel-traversal.md) or use fixed-resolution grids [3D Bresenham Voxel Traversal](3951-3d-bresenham-voxel-traversal.md), this family skips empty internal nodes or adjusts mip-levels dynamically to balance speed and precision [Amanatides-Woo Voxel Traversal](3132-amanatides-woo-voxel-traversal.md)[3D Bresenham Voxel Traversal](3951-3d-bresenham-voxel-traversal.md).

The core mechanism involves maintaining DDA state (`mNext`, `mDelta`, `mStep`) relative to a current dimension `mDim` [Hierarchical Digital Differential Analyzer (HDDA)](1122-hierarchical-digital-differential-analyzer-hdda.md).

This multi-resolution leapfrogging allows the traversal to skip large empty subspaces in single operations, adapting the step size to the current resolution of the tree node or brick being traversed [Hierarchical Digital Differential Analyzer (HDDA)](1122-hierarchical-digital-differential-analyzer-hdda.md)[Multi-level DDA with Adaptive Mip Selection](4086-multi-level-dda-with-adaptive-mip-selection.md).

It is primarily used for volume rendering of densities, ray-level-set intersection, and neural volume rendering with online training [Hierarchical Digital Differential Analyzer (HDDA)](1122-hierarchical-digital-differential-analyzer-hdda.md)[VolumeHDDA](2353-volumehdda.md)[Multi-level DDA with Adaptive Mip Selection](4086-multi-level-dda-with-adaptive-mip-selection.md)[Macro-Cell Optimization](22568-macro-cell-optimization.md).
